steps: Drop the washed spinach into boiling water for 1 to 2 minutes, then lift it straight into cold water.
Drain the spinach well and blend it with the ginger, garlic and green chilli into a smooth paste.
Heat the oil in a pan and let the cumin seeds and bay leaf sizzle.
Add the chopped onion and fry until golden.
Add the tomato and cook until it turns soft and the oil shows at the edges.
Stir in the turmeric, chilli powder and garam masala for half a minute.
Pour in the spinach paste with a splash of water and the salt, and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes.
Add the paneer cubes, cream and crushed kasuri methi, stir for a minute and turn off the heat.
note: Spinach ranged from 45 to 90 g a serving across the sources; 75 g gives a thick green gravy. Onion and tomato are higher than before to match two of the three sources.
